data.title: Week Begins with Robotics Prep for Spacewalk and Advanced Research - NASA
data.description: Expedition 75 began the week gearing up for a spacewalk to upgrade the International Space Station’s power generation system. Research into bioprinted blood vessels and relaxation techniques, as well cargo operations rounded out Monday’s schedule.
data.keywords: Commercial Resupply, Expedition 75, International Space Station (ISS), ISS Research, SpaceX Commercial Resupply
